cap: Functional cysts are exaggerations of the normal cycle. A follicular cyst is a follicle that never ruptured, a corpus luteum cyst can bleed, and theca lutein cysts fill both ovaries when hCG is very high and shrink as it falls. A heavy ovary can twist on its pedicle: the thin-walled veins and lymphatics collapse first, then the artery, and the ovary infarcts.
